title: Metadata-driven pipelines for a thousand plant and supply-chain data consumers
summary: A food manufacturer describes a Databricks-centred platform serving about a thousand data consumers and fifty use cases across twenty factories with metadata- and event-driven pipelines, reporting multi-million annual savings from reduced factory losses.
